channel.title: The Living Church - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Living Church (livingchurch.org)

item.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly (Palm Sunday, Year A)
item.description: The sustenance for the journey to the Promised Land would not be manna, the bread of angels, or matzah, the bread of flight, but the broken body of the Lord.

item.title: Quakers Republish Historic Book to Honor Abp. Mullally - The Living Church
item.description: Archbishop Sarah Mullally is part of a long lineage of English female preachers that includes Margaret Fell, the cofounder of Quakerism, who wrote the first lengthy defense of women’s preaching.

item.title: The ‘Transitional’ Diaconate Is Not a Thing - The Living Church
item.description: Deacons are deacons regardless of whether they are also to be ordained priest. The terms "transitional" and "vocational" are problematic.

item.title: A Warm Welcome from Latin America for Archbishop Mullally - The Living Church
item.description: From Cuba through Mexico, Central America, Brazil, Colombia, and Ecuador, lay people and clergy from the various Anglican communities celebrated.

item.title: Bishops, Deans Ponder Future of Theological Education - The Living Church
item.description: Bishops met for three days with seminary deans and discussed the Nairobi-Cairo Proposals, strategic plans, and prayer book revision.
